name: GrassShadowLab
description: SINGLE-BLADE shadow rig. A Stone plane spawns NO grass blades (blades are emitted only for grass-topped voxels), so placing exactly ONE Grass voxel with bladesPerVoxel=1 yields literally one blade in the entire world. Nothing else can cast: no flora, no trees, no terrain relief, no streaming. Built after repeatedly mis-testing grass shadows in the full forest world, where 'bladesPerVoxel=1' actually meant ~10^5 blades and every reading was confounded. Driven by tools/grass_shadow_lab.py.

world._comment_streaming: streaming MUST stay false: a streaming world would page in fresh grass-topped chunks around the camera and silently reintroduce thousands of extra casters mid-test.
world._comment_flora: flora:false disables the decoration pass entirely — no trees or bushes anywhere, so the only shadow caster in the world is the one blade under test.

camera._comment: Overwritten by the harness; the rig pins its own pose so runs are comparable.
